violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Fans in Meat cooler need to be cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Hoods in deli area found dirty/ dusty.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. - Togo containers found on floor in storage area.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. - Meat dept was found with no soap at hand wash station.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Walls in deli by fryers found dirty/dusty.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 140F or above during display or service. - Ranch beans found in hot hold at a temp of 125F due to the hot hold machine being turned off.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Fans in produce need to be cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. - Leaking sanitizer in meat dept.
Handwashing lavatories. — --- Meat dept handwash station had parts for grinder in the handwash station.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floors in the meat walk-in cooler need to be cleaned.
